author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: सर्वाश्चर्यमयं सर्वाश्चर्यात्मकम् । तादात्म्यार्थे मयट् । देवं क्रीडादिगुणम् । अनन्तं देशकालगुणापरिच्छिन्नम् । विश्वतोमुखं सर्वदिक्षु मुखं यस्य तद्विश्वतोमुखम् । अनन्तमुखमिति वा ॥ ११.११॥
translation: The form with many mouths and eyes, in which many marvels are seen, with many divine ornaments, with many up-raised divine weapons (10), wearing divine wreaths and vestments, anointed with divine pigments, the embodiment of all marvels, brilliant, boundless, with face turned everywhere: (10-11)
